blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Patra Lekhan covers the rules and structural points for writing Sarkari Patra (official letters).
Nibandh Lekhan provides targeted essay topics designed for the Rajbhasha Adhikari Examination.
Precis Writing (Saar Lekhan) emphasizes the skill of concise summarization.
Understanding Important Alankar (Figures of Speech) is essential for mastering Hindi literary and writing techniques.

blocks.content: Good Hindi letter writing requires: correct grammar and spelling, appropriate vocabulary, formal or informal tone as needed, clear structure (beginning, middle, end), use of salutation and complimentary close appropriate to context, and avoidance of literal translations from English.

items: संख्या एवं दिनांक (Number and Date) :top left

विषय (Subject) :underlined; brief and specific

महोदय / महोदया (Salutation)
मुख्य विषय (Body) :2-3 paragraphs; first para: reference context; second: main matter; third: expected action/conclusion
धन्यवाद (Concluding line)

हस्ताक्षर, नाम, पदनाम (Signature, Name, Designation)

blocks.content: Saar Lekhan (Precis writing) is the art of expressing the main ideas of a passage in one's own words, concisely, without losing the essential meaning. It should be about 1/3rd the length of the original. For official Hindi exams, this tests comprehension and expression skills.

items: Sarkari Patra structure points are frequently tested in descriptive Hindi paper formats.
Precis Writing (Saar Lekhan) requires strict adherence to conciseness while retaining central ideas.
Alankar (Figures of Speech) questions commonly appear in objective and analytical Hindi grammar sections.
Read the passage carefully twice
Identify the central theme and key points
Write in third person (avoid using 'I' or 'you')
Use past tense in precis writing
Do not add personal opinion; stick to the passage
Give an appropriate title that captures the theme
Length: approximately 1/3rd of original; count words

cells: Same consonant sound repeated in close succession
कानन कठिन भयंकर भारी :'क' repeated; तरनि तनूजा तट तमाल तरुवर बहु छाए
काली घटा का घमंड घटा :'घटा' means cloud AND diminished
One word with two or more meanings simultaneously
जो रहीम गति दीप की :दीप means lamp AND generous person
Comparison using like/as (सा, सी, सम, जैसा); four parts: Upamey, Upaman, Sadharan Dharm, Vachak Shabd
मुख चंद्रमा सा सुंदर है :(upamey: मुख, upaman: चंद्रमा)
Direct identification; no 'like/as'; identity of upamey and upaman
मानो मदमाती मृग-मन उर अनंग उर धारत :'मानो' signals utpreksha
आगे नदियाँ पड़ी अपार, घोड़ा कैसे उतरे पार :exaggeration of river
